subject.title: openai-completions: chat-completions refusal field dropped, assistant turn resolves to empty content

question: Which open candidate should maintainers treat as the canonical fix for this chat-completions refusal-drop issue?
rationale: The issue itself is a clear bug, but there are four open closing PRs for the same root cause and only one should land.

options.title: Use the proof-sufficient candidate
options.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102344` as canonical because it covers both assembler surfaces, is mergeable, and has sufficient-proof / ready-for-maintainer-look labels.

options.title: Choose a sibling PR
options.body: Pick another open candidate if its final diff or maintainer preference is stronger, then close the remaining duplicate candidates after merge.

options.title: Request consolidation
options.body: Ask contributors to consolidate the best pieces into one branch if maintainers do not want to choose directly between duplicate implementations.

recommendation.title: Use the proof-sufficient candidate
recommendation.body: Treat `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102344` as canonical because it covers both assembler surfaces, is mergeable, and has sufficient-proof / ready-for-maintainer-look labels.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses the shared `packages/ai` runtime and duplicate landing workflow where recent history shows shared AI runtime ownership.
